thread:
kevin: Customer reported automation executed twice and charged twice after a tool call failed validation. request_id=cli-9c3b, account=acme-org. Customer says they sent a single request and our webhook ran the external action twice. :confused:

maria: Can you paste the original payload + the SDK call they used? Also any logs from our side (tool invocation, fallback behavior).

kevin: Paste below — they called /v1/chat with function schema that didn't match the tool's strict validator, model returned a function call but with malformed args, our runtime responded 202 and queued the tool invocation. Customer saw two external POSTs within seconds. Payload snippet:

kevin: ```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4x-internal",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"send invoice to bob@example.com for $1200"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"send_invoice","parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"recipient":"string","amount":"number","due_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["recipient","amount"]}}],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

maria: Thanks. Do we have the trace for the function_call lifecycle? I want to see our decision: did we fallback to LLM execution (non-tool) after a schema validation error or did we retry the tool?

jake: Pasted trace from runtime (sanitized):

jake: ```
[1765432100.102] received chat request cli-9c3b
[1765432100.210] model -> function_call send_invoice with args: {recipient: "bob@example.com", amount: "1200"}  // amount is a string -> schema mismatch
[1765432100.215] validator: schema mismatch -> reject payload for tool
[1765432100.220] runtime: queued fallback path -> call llm handler (non-tool) with original content
[1765432101.030] external-tool-dispatch: status=202 accepted, execution_id=exec-44
[1765432103.500] retry policy triggered: missing exec confirmation -> re-dispatch external-tool-dispatch exec-45
[1765432103.505] external-target received POST exec-44
[1765432103.506] external-target received POST exec-45
```

maria: Ugh. So two things happening: we fallback to LLM handler when schema doesn't validate, and our tool-dispatch path still enqueues the tool (maybe from earlier branch). Then our retry logic sees no execution confirmation fast enough and re-dispatches, causing duplicate POSTs.

kevin: Customer says the external system performed the action on the first POST, and billed them. They expected idempotency. They used the SDK default (no idempotency_token) and didn't get duplicates on their side. We should own this. :facepalm:

jake: Short-term mitigation: disable automatic fallback to non-tool when validator fails for customers on Dedicated/Private? Or at least block dispatch of external-tool if validator rejects args. Also add idempotency token generation on our side for tool dispatch HTTP webhook (attach execution_id as idempotency-key header).

maria: Agree. For this customer I can push a hotfix: ensure we cancel queued dispatch if validator fails OR route to human review instead of dispatch. Kevin, can you ask customer for the exact timestamps of the two POSTs and the external target's request IDs? We'll correlate with exec-44/45.

kevin: Done, provided timestamps from customer: 2025-06-05T18:05:03.506Z and 2025-06-05T18:05:03.505Z (they're the two). Also sending external request IDs and sample headers.

support-bot: Alert attached: billing-duplicate-charge acme-org cli-9c3b — severity=high. Please triage.

jake: Repro attempt notes: I crafted a minimal test where the model returns amount as string (common with NLG). With `function_call: auto` and strict validator, our validator rejects but the dispatch flow still logs a queued dispatch when the model suggested the function. If the dispatch path receives no ack from the executor within 2s, it triggers a fast retry (backoff=0.5s) — this combination leads to near-simultaneous duplicate POSTs.

maria: Plan: (1) patch runtime to gate tool dispatch on validator success (no dispatch if validator rejected), (2) attach execution_id as Idempotency-Key header on outbound webhook, (3) increase initial retry backoff and make retries idempotent-aware, (4) create an emergency rule to pause tool dispatches for the customer's org while we validate. I'll open a PR and a deploy request.

kevin: Customer asked for interim workaround: can we pause tool execution for their org? If yes, they want us to replay once fixed.

jake: ops-bot run org-pause acme-org tool-dispatch -> returns ok. (ops-bot message: executed).

ops-bot: org pause enacted for acme-org: tool dispatch suspended.

maria: I'll do the hotfix branch now, tag @jake for review. Also adding a note to billing to reverse duplicate charge after we confirm replay won't repeat the action.

kevin: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated and escalate to account team for refund path. Please add any logs or PR links here when available. :thumbsup:
